turns.content: Hi there! I recently bought a new road bike, and I want to make sure I'm taking good care of it. Could you give me some maintenance tips to keep it in top shape?

Start your bike life with a clean, thorough inspection to check tire pressure, brake cable function, and quick-release skewers. Regularly clean the frame and lubricate the chain every few weeks to prevent friction wear. Always check for any loose bolts and keep an eye on your brakes and gears as your riding improves.
